thread:
Priya: FYI Nightwatch booked 2026-07-09 -> 2026-07-11. We need a concrete evidence custody + access playbook: ephemeral RBAC, KMS-scoped decrypt, audit snapshot/export, manifest format, retest gates. Who can own each piece?

Luka: I'll take RBAC. staging + preprod only. I'll draft ephemeral role trust + permission boundary. TTL 6h sounds reasonable.

Tessa: I'll own audit exports and manifest indexing. Plan: CloudTrail + app-auth logs exported at t0 and t_end, plus a running copy in pen-test-ingest/YYYYMMDD/ for chain-of-custody.

Arun: I'll run the remediation board and block retest windows. Tentative retest slots: 2026-07-23 and 2026-07-30 (2 weeks apart). I'll add gating checklist for scheduling.

Luka: IAM sketch (I'll open PR):
```
aws iam create-role --role-name nightwatch-assessor-staging \
  --assume-role-policy-document file://assume-policy.json
# inline policy: s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject on pen-test-ingest/*
# kms:Decrypt scoped to arn:aws:kms:...:alias/nightwatch-evidence
# permission boundary: deny access outside pen-test-ingest prefix
```

Priya: Important KMS note: alias/nightwatch-evidence exists. No cross-account grants. Use short-lived role with kms:Decrypt allowed only for that alias; do not export key material or create grants.

Tessa: Manifest template (store with each object under pen-test-ingest/YYYYMMDD/manifest-<id>.json):
```
{
  "uploader": "Nightwatch",
  "object_key": "pen-test-ingest/20260709/session-42.enc",
  "kms_key_alias": "alias/nightwatch-evidence",
  "uploaded_at": "2026-07-09T14:05:00Z",
  "sha256": "sha256:...",
  "uploader_contact": "vendor@example.com"
}
```

Arun: Retest eligibility (draft): 1) Fix merged + deployed to staging, 2) Triage owner verifies remediation and closes ticket, 3) Evidence artifacts and manifest present in S3, 4) Automated smoke/regression checks pass, 5) Remediation owner requests retest slot. I'll make this checklist required on the pt board.

Luka: Upload flow: prefer presigned PUTs to avoid sharing KMS. Vendor encrypts client-side. Example (node):
```
const url = await s3.getSignedUrlPromise('putObject', { Bucket, Key, Expires: 3600 })
// vendor uploads ciphertext to URL
```

Tessa: Audit export plan: snapshot at t0 and t_end into s3://redwood-audit/nightwatch/ with SSE-KMS alias/nightwatch-audit. We'll keep an index file listing manifests and snapshot checksums for auditors. Retention bump to 90d for engagement, then archive to long-term store.

security-oncall: Escalation rule: if vendor reports confirmed exploitable SEV1, create channel #incident-pt-nightwatch and page oncall. Target ack <= 15m. Include remediation board link and latest manifest index in the page payload.

Priya: Legal/controls: need signed NDA/DPA that includes explicit KMS constraint and retention clause. @Legal can you prioritize?

Legal: pinged. Will review and request adding the KMS alias + retention 90d clause to the vendor agreement. Can do fast-track if we add clause now.

Arun: CI-bot friendly note: I'll add labels pt-sev1/2/3, and a column awaiting-retest. I'll reserve the calendar slots and link board tickets to calendar events.

Luka: Operational detail: role trust policy will require MFA and restrict principal to vendor AWS account + vendor-assessor principals. I'll also enforce condition aws:RequestedRegion to our staging region.

Tessa: Chain-of-custody: keep a manifest index file at pen-test-ingest/YYYYMMDD/index.json with entries for each manifest and include checksum to ensure integrity. I'll provide a small verification script.

Priya: No SSH to hosts. If assessors request live sessions, provide recorded replay or jumpbox session recordings only. Deny direct session tokens.

Luka: TTL enforcement: lambda rota that revokes active sessions after TTL (6h) and removes role inline policies on expiry. I'll add logs to CloudWatch and include event in audit snapshot.

Arun: Retest scheduling policy: minimum 7 business days after remediation ticket close unless triage owner requests expedited slot. Prefer 10 business days for medium/low. High/critical handled case-by-case.

Tessa: I'll upload runbook to s3://redwood-internal/pt-runbooks/nightwatch-202607 with CloudTrail export commands and quick Athena queries for STS:AssumeRole failure spikes.

ci-bot: PR #1102 created (iam/nightwatch-ephemeral + bucket policy). CI: checks pending...

Priya: Owners recap: RBAC=Luka, KMS/audit/Triage logs=Tessa, Remediation+retest=Arun, Incident=security-oncall, Legal=Legal. Action owners, please post links to PRs/runbooks here so I can do the vendor handshake.

Luka: PR incoming in 30m, tagging @Priya for review.

Tessa: Runbook uploaded (draft) and link posted on the pt board. Includes manifest verifier script and sample Athena queries.

Legal: NDA draft updated with KMS alias + 90d retention clause, sent to vendor for signature.

Arun: Board created and retest slots on calendar. Setting gating checks to blocked until manifest + smoke tests are present.

Priya: Great. One-pager: I'll assemble links (PR, runbook, board, calendar) and publish onboarding doc for assessors. Handshake scheduled Fri 09:30 PT. Thanks team :rocket:
